description: Atomic icon primitive. Renders either a Font Awesome glyph (default template) or a registered inline SVG (svg template). Replaces the ad-hoc `<i class="fa-... sherpa-icon">` pattern used elsewhere in the library and gives consumers a single, declarative way to reference icons by name.

attributes.name: data-weight
attributes.description: solid (default) | regular | light | thin | duotone | brands

attributes.name: data-status
attributes.description: critical | warning | success | info | urgent | brand

methods.name: static register(name, svgString) — Register a custom inline SVG icon.
static has(name)                  — Check whether a name is registered.
static unregister(name)            — Remove a registered icon.
